blocks.content: Here is the complete quiz game in one place. Every part comes from the chapters we've built: variables, conditionals, user input, loops, arrays, and objects.
Run it in your console environment.
We've brought it all together: one game loop that welcomes, asks each question, validates input, tracks score and wrong answers, shows the summary, and lets the player replay or quit.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
